title: Fix knowledge corpus integrity issues
summary: BCQuality knowledge articles and skill documentation were corrected to fix broken references, mismatched examples, and scope constraints without changing the underlying knowledge or findings.
key_points: Dead knowledge and sample references in skill documentation were replaced with canonical current articles
Articles for DataTransfer, teaching-tips, and this keyword guidance were scoped to Business Central versions that support these features
